metadata.title: Chayote squash a better option than cabbage for momo filling
metadata.description: These chayote squash momos are a fresh twist on the classic. Unlike regular cabbage-filled momos, chayote brings a subtle sweetness, tender crunch, and juicier bite—making each dumpling lighter, more flavorful, and utterly satisfying. Once you try these, cabbage momos might just feel a little bland.
